title: Singapore PM Lawrence Wong says he doesn't want Singapore used to circumvent US chip export controls, as authorities probe Megaspeed's purchases of Nvidia chips (Philip Heijmans/Bloomberg)
summary: Philip Heijmans / Bloomberg: Singapore PM Lawrence Wong says he doesn't want Singapore used to circumvent US chip export controls, as authorities probe Megaspeed's purchases of Nvidia chips — Prime Minister Lawrence Wong doesn't want Singapore to be used as a route for companies seeking to circumvent US chip export controls …
